विप् [cf. Lat. vibrare; Goth. weiþan; Germ. wîfen, weifen, Wipfel Eng. whiffle.]
2. विप् mfn. inwardly stirred or excited, inspired, RV.

a finger, Naigh. ii, 5.
a: विप् — {c10c} A. (वेपयति-ते) To throw, cast.
विप् — m. 1 A praiser, singer of hymns. --2 A wise man. --f. 1 Praise, a hymn. --2 A finger.

ripening, maturing (esp. of the fruit of actions), effect, result, consequence (of actions in the present or former births pursuing those who commit them through subsequent existences), Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
maturing of food (in the stomach), digestion, conversion of food into a state for assimilation, MBh.; Hariv.; Suśr.
bad digestion, Car.
any change of form or state, Uttarar.
calamity, distress, misfortune, Yājñ.; Uttarar.

a: विपाकः — 1 Cooking, dressing. --2 Digestion. --3 Ripening, ripeness, maturity, development (fig. also); अमी पृथुस्तंबभृतः पिशंगतां गता विपाकेन फलस्य शालयः Ki. 4. 26; वाचां विपाको मम Bv. 4. 42 ‘my mature, full-developed, or dignified words’. --4 Consequence, fruit, result, the result of actions either in this or in a former birth; अहो मे दारुणतरः कर्मणां विपाकः K. 354; ममैव जन्मांतरपातकानां विपाकविस्फूर्जथुरषसह्यः R. 14. 62; Bh. 2. 99; Mv. 5. 56. --5 (a) Change of state; कष्टं बतान्यदिव दैववशेन जाता दुःखात्मकं किमपि भूतमहो विपाकः U. 4. 6. (b) An unexpected event or occurrence, a reverse, adverse turn of fate, distress, calamity; रिदृशानां विपाकोऽपि जायते परमाद्भुतः U. 3. 3; विपाके घोरेऽस्मिन्नथ खलु विमूढा तव सखी 4. 12. --6 Difficulty, embarrassment. --7 Flavour, taste.

of a Dānava (father of Rāhu), Suparṇ.; MBh. &c. (cf. -चित्)

disappeared, vanished, gone, ib.
deprived or destitute of, without, lacking (instr.), ib.
a: विप्रहीण — a. Deprived or destitute of.

trodden (see अ-व्˚).
विप्र—जूत (विप्र-), mfn. impelled or urged by the wise, RV.
विप्र—जूति m. N. of a man (with the patr. Vātaraśana, author of RV. x, 136, 3), Anukr.
विप्र—जन m. a Br˚ or a priest (also collectively), MBh.
N. of a man (with the patr. Saurāki), Kāṭh.
विप्रजित्ति m. N. of a preceptor, ŚBr. (cf. विप्र-चित्ति).
वि—प्रकाश mfn. (ifc.) = प्रकाश, resembling, similar to, Hariv.

retaliation, W.
various manner, MW. (rather fr. वि-प्र-√ कॄ).
a: विप्रकारः — 1 Insult, contumely, abuse, treating with disrespect; Ki. 3. 55. --2 Injury, offence. --3 Wickedness. --4 Opposition, counteraction. --5 Retaliation.

k.v: निकारो विप्रकारः स्यादाकारस्त्विङ्ग इङ्गितम्. परिणामो विकारे द्वे समे विकृतिविक्रिये॥

dishevelled, loose (see comp.), extended, wide, spacious, R.
a: विप्रकीर्ण — p. p. 1 Spread about, dispersed, scattered. --2 Loose, dishevelled (as hair). --3 Expanded, outstretched. --4 Wide, broad.

m: वि-प्र-कीर्ण—शिरोरुह mfn. having dishevelled or flowing hair, MBh. iii, 401
विप्रक m. a contemptible Brāhman, Kautukas.
विप्र—कन्या f. a Brāhman girl, MW.
वि-˚प्रकर्तृ mfn. injuring an injurer, offender, ib.

difference, contrast, MBh.
(in gram.) the separation of two consonants by the insertion of a vowel.
a: विप्रकर्षः — Distance, remoteness.

a: विप्रकृ — {c8c} U. 1 (a) To tease, trouble, harass, harm; किं सत्त्वानि विप्रकरोषि Ś. 7; (b) To oppress; तस्मिन् विप्रकृताः काले तारकेण दिवौकसः Ku. 2. 1. --2 To wrong, ill-treat, offend; Ś. 4. 17. --3 To affect, cause a change in; कमपरमवशं नविप्रकुर्युर्विभुमपि तं यदमी स्पृशंति भावाः Ku. 6. 95. --4 To disfigure, deform; आभरणोचितं रूपमाश्रमसुलभैः प्रसाधनैर्विप्रकार्यते Ś. 4.

m: वि-प्रकृत् mfn. hurting, injuring, offending (with gen.), BhP.

thwarted, frustrated, MBh.

k.v: निकृतः स्याद्विप्रकृतो विप्रलब्धस्तु वञ्चितः। मनोहतः प्रतिहतः प्रतिबद्धो हतश्च सः॥

injury, offence, opposition, retaliation, W.
a: विप्रकृतिः — f. 1 Injury, offence. --2 An insult, abuse, contumely. --3 Retaliation, retort.

a: विप्रकृष् — {c1c} P. To draw away, remove, counteract; U. 5. 31.

talking idly, prattle, Suśr.
mutual contradiction, Pāṇ. i, 3, 50
breaking of a promise or engagement, deception, L.

a: विप्रलभ् — {c1c} A. 1 To cheat, deceive, impose upon. --2 To recover, regain. --3 To insult, disrespect. --4 To violate, disregard.

(b) Delusion; अतिक्लामिता खलु प्रियसखी अनेनानुकूलविप्रलंभेन Māl. 6. --2 Especially, deceiving by false statement or by not keeping promises. --3 Quarrel, disagreement. --4 Disunion, separation, disjunction. --5 The separation of lovers; शुश्रुवे प्रियजनस्य कातरं विप्रलंभपरिशंकिनो वचः R. 19. 18; Ve. 2. 12. --6 (In Rhet.) The feeling or sentiment of love in separation, one of the two main kinds of शृंगार (opp. संभोग); अपरः (विप्रलंभः) अभिलाषविरहेर्ष्याप्रवासशापहेतुक इति पंचविधः K. P. 4; यूनोरयुक्तयोर्भावो युक्तयोर्वाथवा मिथः . अभीष्टालिंगनादीनामनवाप्तौ प्रहृष्यते . विप्रलंभः स विज्ञेयः -उज्ज्वलमणिः; cf. S. D. 212 et seq.
विप्रलंभनं — Deception, fraud, trick.

D. : --प्रियः कृत्वापि संकेतं यस्या नायाति संनिधिम् . विप्रलब्धेति सा ज्ञेया नितांतमवमानिता .. 118.

disunion, disjunction, W.
quarrel, disagreement, ib.

वि-प्र-लप्त n. discussion, debate, disquisition, MBh.
a: विप्रलप्तं — 1 Discussion, debate, controversy. --2 Bewailing, lamentation.

वि-प्रलुम्पक mfn. rapacious, exacting, avaricious, Mn. viii, 309.

interrupted, disturbed, BhP.

विप्र—मन्मन् (विप्र-), mfn. having an inspired mind, RV.
वि—प्रमत्त mfn. (prob.) not neglected, Kathās. xxxiv, 255.
वि-˚प्रमोच्य mfn. to be liberated or freed from (abl.), R.
वि-प्रमोह m. committing a fault, transgression (in अ-विप्र्˚), ĀśvŚr.
वि-˚प्रमोहित mfn. confused, perplexed, bewildered, MBh.
वि-प्र-मोक्ष m. (√ मोक्ष्) loosening, release, ChUp.; Sarvad.
deliverance from (abl. or gen.), MBh.; Hcat.
वि-˚प्रमोक्षण n. (ifc.) deliverance from, Hariv.; Sarvad.

a: विप्रमुच् — See प्रमुच्.

वि-प्रमुक्त mfn. loosened &c.
discharged, shot, hurled, R.
delivered or freed from (instr. or comp.), MBh.; BhP.
v.l. for वि-प्रयुक्त (below)
a: विप्रमुक्त — p. p. 1 Set free, liberated, loosened. --2 Shot, discharged. --3 Free from (in comp.).

m: वि-प्रमुक्त—भय mfn. removed from danger, free from fear, Hariv.
वि-˚प्रनष्ट mfn. (not ˚प्रणष्ट, cf. Pāṇ. viii, 4, 36) lost, disappeared, gone, fruitless, vain, MBh.

a: विप्रनष्ट — p. p. 1 Lost. --2 Vain, useless.

a precipice, abyss, MBh.

reversed, inverted, Ratnāv.

वि-˚प्रतिकार m. counteraction, opposition, reverse, retaliation, ib.
a: विप्रतिकारः — 1 Counteraction, opposition, contradiction. --2 Retaliation.

to be variously acquired, ib.

of opposite opinion, dissentient, Śaṃk.; Sarvad.
wrong, false (as an opinion), Pat.
having a false opinion, being mistaken about or in (loc.), Car.
forbidden, prohibited, Āpast.
conversant or acquainted with in various ways, W.
mutually connected, ib.
a: विप्रतिपन्न — p. p. 1 Mutually opposed, opposite, dissentient. --2 Confused, bewildered, perplexed. --3 Contested, disputed. --4 Mutually connected or related.

incompatibility of two conceptions, opposition of one rule to another, Sarvad.
erroneous perception or notion, error, mistake, Suśr.; Car.
suspicion about (loc.), Jātakam.
aversion, hostile feeling or treatment, ib.
false reply or objection (in argument), Nyāyas.
various acquirement, conversancy, W.
mutual connection or relation, ib.

afflicted, dejected, ib.

opposition, contradiction, contrariety, conflict (of two statements), ŚrS.; Śaṃk. &c. (esp. in gram., प्रतिषेधे, where there is a conflict between two rules, Pāṇ. i, 4, 2; ˚धेन, in consequence of a conflict of two rules, iv, 1, 170 Vārtt. 1; पूर्व-विप्रतिषेध, a conflict of two rules of which the former prohibits the latter, iv, 2, 39 Vārtt. 1; पर-व्˚, a conflict of two rules of which the latter prohibits the former, ii, 2, 35, Vārtt. 1, Pat.)
prohibition, negation, annulment, Nyāyas.
a: विप्रतिषेधः — 1 Keeping under control, controlling; क्रव्याद्भ्य इव भूतानामदांतेभ्यः सदा भयम् . तेषां विप्रतिषेधार्थं राजा सृष्टः स्वयंभुवा Mb. --2 The opposition of two courses of action which are equally important, the conflict of two even-matched interests; हरिर्विप्रतिषेधं तमाच चक्षे विचक्षणः Śi. 2. 6 (तुल्यबलविरोधो विप्रतिषेधः Malli.). --3 (In gram.) The conflict of two different grammatical operations become possible according to two different rules, conflict of two equally important rules; विप्रतिषेधे परं कार्यं P. I. 4. 2; विरोधो विप्रतिषेधः . यत्र द्वौ प्रसंगावन्यार्थावेकस्मिन् प्राप्नुतः स विप्रतिषेधः Kāśikā.; See Mbh. also. --4 Prohibition.
